description: Pinned ProveKit toolchain for anon-credit phase 1. tooling/provekit/pins.env has the same values.

provekit.localPatch: tooling/provekit/patches/0001-provekit-wasm-optional-threads.patch (adds the optional `threads` feature to tooling/provekit-wasm for the scalar build; the published SDK branch has the same feature)

publishedBrowserSdk.reason: At its source commit the witness commitment is non-hiding (WhirR1CSScheme docs: 'Witness ZK is off ... WHIR openings leak witness values'). It also rejects the PKP/PKV 3.0 artifacts of the pinned rev. No branch has both the JS SDK and the hiding witness mode.

alternativeRelease.note: Stable v1 line. Witness commitment uses whir_zk (always zero knowledge) with a blinded sumcheck. Noir 1.0.0-beta.26 through provekit_* crates. Its provekit-wasm has no single-thread feature, and no published JS SDK matches it. Not used by the gate.
